label: Scrapbook
description: A short personal film: a few pictures, a line each, pinned askew on paper and drifting past to music. Lays itself out with stand-in pages until your own photos arrive.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.description: Under the title: a date range, a place, a dedication.

photos.label: Photos
photos.description: The pictures, in order. Leave empty to lay the film out with generated stand-in pages and drop real ones in later.

notes.label: Notes
notes.description: One line per picture, in the same order. A blank entry leaves that page wordless.

music.label: Music
music.description: Optional music bed under the whole film.

xfadeMs.label: Page turn
xfadeMs.description: Cross-fade between pages (ms) — the page turn.

drift.label: Drift
drift.description: How far each picture drifts while it holds. 0 = perfectly still.

tilt.label: Tilt
tilt.description: How far off square a picture is pinned, in degrees.

paperColor.label: Paper
paperColor.description: The paper the scrapbook is made of.

accentColor.label: Accent
accentColor.description: The one colour that is not paper or ink.
